vi: Khai báo Launch Template versioned (blueprint immutable) thay vì Launch Configuration deprecated, bump version tự động khi AMI thay đổi
Thiết kế Auto Scaling Group multi-AZ spread với min/max/desired capacity, self-heal failed instance, target-tracking scaling policy bám metric CPU/memory/ALB request count
Implement lifecycle hook ở state Terminating:Wait để drain connection, flush cache, checkpoint trước khi terminate (ngược lại immediate kill)
Chạy instance refresh rolling update zero-downtime: terminate old instance, launch new từ template version mới, observe CloudWatch metrics transition
Debug ASG cost leak: orphan instance không terminate, desired-capacity > actual, scaling policy thrash từ metric noise, launch template version chưa delete
en: Declare versioned Launch Template (immutable blueprint) instead of deprecated Launch Configuration, auto-bump version when AMI changes
Design Auto Scaling Group spread across multi-AZ with min/max/desired capacity, self-heal failed instances, target-tracking scaling policy on CPU/memory/ALB request count
Implement lifecycle hook at Terminating:Wait state to drain connections, flush cache, checkpoint before termination (versus immediate kill)
Run instance refresh rolling update with zero downtime: terminate old instance, launch new from new template version, observe CloudWatch metrics transition
Debug ASG cost leaks: orphan instances not terminating, desired-capacity exceeds actual, scaling policy thrash from metric noise, unused launch template versions
